advisory.finding: Enabling mixed bedrock+anthropic fallback chains on the frontier and standard classes silently disables prompt caching for both classes project-wide, because `_intersect_capabilities` collapses `prompt_cache_style` to 'none' whenever candidate styles differ. This cost is documented in a comment but no test guards it, so a later change (e.g. aligning cache styles, or reordering candidates) could regress the tradeoff undetected.
scenarios: Every standard- and frontier-class agentic call now runs without prompt caching on the Bedrock primary, increasing token cost/latency vs. the pre-change single-arm bedrock config.
A future edit that changes candidate ordering or cache-style resolution silently re-enables or further degrades caching with no failing test.
